nonBlockingObservations.title: Keep native name bounds separate from the synthetic over-envelope control
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The native macOS directory stream returns at most 1023 bytes before its required NUL, so the revised production envelope is sound. The injected 1024-byte control is outside that native contract. Its implementation should retain and charge the full injected refusal bytes, or reject at the bounded stream boundary, rather than truncate to 1023 and describe the result as the complete escaped name. This is an implementation-control detail, not a blocker to the plan.
